title: Simultaneous derived reduction and normalized diagonal-system predicates
statement:
Let $\ell$ be a natural number, $\mathcal A,\mathcal B$ abelian categories with chosen unbounded derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], and $L:\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$ a functor. Use strict inverse systems [def-weil-inverse-system], indexed by $n\geq0$ with coefficient exponent $n+1$. An ordinary reduction presentation is an additive functor $E:\mathcal A\to(\mathbf N^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathcal B)$ with natural maps $\pi_n:L\to E_n$ exhibiting $E_n(M)$ as the cokernel of $\ell^{n+1}$ on $L(M)$ and commuting with the quotient transitions. A simultaneous derived reduction consists of this presentation, a functor $T:D(\mathcal A)\to D(\mathbf N^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathcal B)$, its universal left-derived counit $QT\to E_{\mathrm{complex}}Q$, the pointwise existence condition at every complex, and exactness with a shift comparison.

For prime $\ell$ and a scheme $X$, on the small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], define scalar extension from abelian sheaves to sheaves of discrete constant $\mathbf Z_\ell$-modules [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] by sectionwise extension along $\mathbf Z\to\mathbf Z_\ell$ followed by sheafification. For a simultaneous derived reduction $D$ of this functor, the completion predicate means: there are an integral reduction presentation for the identity, total right derived limits on both tower categories, an isomorphism between the resulting completion functors after forgetting scalars, and a natural unit into this completion whose output is right orthogonal to every complex on which $\ell$ is invertible and which induces a bijection on maps to every such complete object.

For a scheme $Y$ with $\ell$ invertible, put $P=\mathbf P^1_Y$, $W=P\times_Y P$ and let $\Delta:P\hookrightarrow W$ be the diagonal. The diagonal-cycle-system predicate for $D$ on $W$ means that there exist one strict system $H$ identified with the roots tower of [def-pur-roots-of-unity-sheaf], [sk-def-sp-tate-twist], source and shifted-target isomorphisms, and a degree-two system Ext class. Its source isomorphism is exactly the single-object comparison of the universal derived counit. Its class is the image under $T$ of the positive Cartier pole boundary [def-sp-cartier-pole-boundary], through these isomorphisms. At every $n\geq0$ there are supported constant and Tate-line identifications: the former preserves the quotient-unit generator, the latter is the specified root-to-line map, and the transported Ext class equals the finite pro-etale Cartier class of [def-sfb-cartier-reduction-data] with exponent $\ell^{n+1}$. All size/localization instances are part of the supplied presentations. These define data and predicates, not their existence.
